name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain=animate>_<descriptor=palette_flash_pulse_white>; no Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix). Accurately reflects an animated palette flash that pulses the whole DAC toward white and back. Consistent with the fd2_animate_* family (e.g. fd2_animate_screen_shake).
purpose: Plays a pulse-white palette flash: additively brightens the entire VGA DAC (indices 0..0xFF) toward white, holds at peak, then fades back to normal.
logic_summary: Fade UP loop: brightness = 0..0x3F (64 steps), each step calls fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add(0, 0xFF, brightness) to add the current brightness to all 256 DAC entries (writes ports 0x3C8/0x3C9), then fd2_delay_ms(8) (~8ms) -> ~512ms total. Hold: fd2_delay_ms(400) (~400ms at peak). Fade DOWN loop: brightness = 0x3E..0 (63 steps, signed -1 < (int)brightness termination), same palette-add call + fd2_delay_ms(8) -> ~504ms. Total ~1.4s. CHK(0x14) stack-probe prologue is compiler-generated. EBX is the callee-saved loop counter. cdecl, no params, void return.
comment_original_issue: Src comment claimed the effect is used for 'celebratory / dramatic moments (level-up flash, victory, ch29/ch30 endgame transitions)'. The 'level-up flash, victory' part is unverified speculation: all 3 distinct callers (fd2_chapter_29_end, fd2_chapter_30_init, fd2_chapter_event_handler_4c__ch29_major_cinematic; 7 call sites total) are ch29/ch30 endgame contexts -- there is no level-up or generic-victory caller. The Ghidra plate was already correct ('all 7 call sites are in the ch29/ch30 endgame cinematics').
notes: Decompile matches src body 1:1 (fade-up 0..0x3F, hold 400, fade-down 0x3E..0; fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add(0,0xFF,brightness) + fd2_delay_ms(8) per step). fd2_delay_ms confirmed (from sibling shard 00024b4d) to be a millisecond-delay wrapper, so 8 -> ~8ms and 400 -> ~400ms; brightness 0..0x3F (0..63) is the standard VGA 6-bit DAC range. Callers verified by get_function_by_address: fd2_chapter_29_end @ 0x2548C (void), fd2_chapter_30_init @ 0x33E3C (void), fd2_chapter_event_handler_4c__ch29_major_cinematic @ 0x35D60 -- all endgame. No reads/writes of game globals (only port I/O via the palette-add callee). Name + (no) params kept; only the usage-context line of the src comment corrected to match verified callers. No logic changes.
